description: Karpo is a proactive AI assistant designed to live directly within iMessage, functioning as a native sidekick for city discovery and life administration. By integrating into the messaging platform people already use, Karpo eliminates the need to switch between multiple apps to find recommendations or coordinate plans. Users can interact with the assistant individually or bring it into group chats to streamline the decision-making process for social gatherings. Streamlined Discovery and Planning
